ValidationRule.description: Requires a value for Billing Account for SITAD Upsell/Lift Opportunity before Stage 5 Signed/PO on Standard Opportunities only.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($RecordType.Name == 'Standard Opportunity' && ISBLANK( Billing_Account__c ) && ISPICKVAL(Type, "Up-Sell/Lift") && NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Clari) && (ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c , "DM SITAD") && CONTAINS($Label.QTB_SITAD_Countries, QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c)) && NOT((ISPICKVAL(StageName, "7 - Closed") && CloseDate < DATE(2024,04,19)) || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "6 - Setup")), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission), NOT(Bypass_Validation__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SITAD Up-sell opportunities require an Billing Account
